nares-2p.blocker: NARES-2P P is a midpoint between adjacent S sites, not an intra-nucleotide atomic landmark. S and B supply only two independent local points; rotation about S-B is unconstrained. A base normal or a third intra-nucleotide landmark is required.

nast.blocker: NAST supplies only C3' per nucleotide and no orientation. Three rotational degrees of freedom remain undetermined; two additional non-collinear intra-nucleotide landmarks or an authoritative oriented frame are required.
